note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

title.en: The Greatest Show in the Multiverse

texts.zh:
我们在这颗小行星上发现的发光物体是一则广告。

这个巨大的展示装置由内部占据小行星的机械基础设施支持。小行星本身在空间中的某一点上异常地悬浮着，不受任何附近物体的引力影响。

广告本身是关于它所称之为“多重宇宙的最佳秀场”的内容。有一个终端可以接受能量币，使我们直接前往这个景点。
texts.en:
The brightly lit object we discovered on this asteroid is an advertisement.

This massive display is supported by a mechanical infrastructure occupying the inside of the asteroid it is mounted on. The asteroid itself is anomalously suspended at one point in space, unaffected by the gravitational pull of any nearby object.

The advertisement itself is in reference to what it calls "The Greatest Show in the Multiverse".There is a terminal accepting energy credits for direct transport to the attraction.

label.zh: 重新改造这处标识为我们自己所用。
label.en: Repurpose the sign for our own use.

texts.zh: 在处理完我们的支付款项后，小行星内部的机械开始嗡嗡作响。一股刺眼的蓝光向外射出，精确地分开了时空的织构。当它运转结束时，小行星就消失了，而一道星界裂隙出现在了原地。
texts.en: After processing our payment, the machinery within the asteroid whirred into life. A stream of piercing blue light shot outward, meticulously parting the fabric of space and time. Once its work was finished, the asteroid simply vanished, and an Astral Rift was left in its stead.

texts.zh: 我们用深受认可的本地企业代替了[fromfrom.GetName]的古怪广告商。支付终端被仔细拆解后，我们在里面发现了一小批能量币。
texts.en: We have replaced the anomalous advertisement with an endorsement for our own local businesses at [fromfrom.GetName]. The payment terminal was carefully dismantled, revealing a small cache of energy credits within.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 小行星内部机械中所采纳的技术比我们最初预料的要先进。因此，我们的回收工作给我们带来了相当可观的价值。我们发现了各种稀有材料——其中包括数量惊人的星界丝缕。这颗中空的小行星一定是被设计成能够以某种方式操纵空间和时间。
texts.en: The technology within the asteroid's internal mechanisms were more advanced than initially suspected. As such, its salvage has rewarded us with considerable value. We have uncovered a variety of rare materials - including an anomalous quantity of Astral Threads. The hollowed asteroid must have been designed to manipulate space and time in some fashion.

label.zh: 我们得好好利用这一切。
label.en: We shall put these to good use.

summary.text:
# 探测到光亮物体 / Bright Object Detected

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 2级异常，每帝国一次；权重0，小行星+3，需拥有星界采集科技、尚未探索“星际马戏团”裂隙，且系统没有裂隙/伤疤；生成时设旗标greatest_show_anomaly_found。  
  Level-2 anomaly, once per empire; weight 0, +3 on asteroids, needs astral harvesting and an unexplored interdimensional circus rift, and no rift / scar in the system; sets greatest_show_anomaly_found when spawned.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 单一结局astral_planes.6010“多元宇宙最伟大的表演”（研究）：a付费→6011“星界裂隙出现”；b改作自用广告→6012；c拆解→6013。  
  Single outcome astral_planes.6010 (research): a pays → 6011 "A Rift Appears"; b repurposes the sign → 6012; c scraps it → 6013.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三个选项互斥。  
  The three options are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

  Compared the category script and the tree.
- “星界裂隙出现”类结局会在星系中生成星界裂隙，其后续属于星界裂隙故事（不在本故事内）。  
  "A Rift Appears" outcomes create an astral rift in the system; what follows belongs to the astral rift stories, not this one.
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部5个文档。 / All 5 docs.
